question: The Deccan Riots of 1875 took place in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Deccan Riots of 1875** were a series of riots that took place in the **Deccan region of British India.**
 
• The riots were sparked by** economic grievances** among the** local peasantry,** who were suffering from** high taxes and low crop yields.**
 
• The riots were particularly intense in the districts of **Poona and Satara i**n present-day Maharashtra.
 
• The British colonial government responded to the riots with a **heavy hand, using military force** to suppress the rebellion and arresting many of the leaders.
 
• The **Deccan Riots** were part of a larger wave of **peasant unrest** that swept across India in the late 19th century, as rural communities struggled to cope with the **demands of colonial rule **and **capitalist agriculture.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh:** Himachal Pradesh did not exist as a separate state in 1875.

 
 
• The region was then part of the **British province of Punjab.**
 
 
 
• **Bihar:** Bihar was also part of British India in 1875, but it was **not directly affected** by the Deccan Riots. 
 
• **West Bengal:** West Bengal did not exist as a separate state in **1875**.
 
 
• The region was then part of the British province of Bengal. ​
